name: Ceridwen
subtitle: Guardian of Secrets
description: Enchant your allies with Turn Meter and Divinity gains whilst casting judgement on their Allegiance.
lore: Although believed by some to be a goddess, Ceridwen is a mortal sorceress, albeit a potent one. She can grant mystical wisdom, and transform herself and others. She guards many of Avalon’s secret magics, not only from outsiders but from her countrymen, reserving their powers to benefit her children—of which she has several, both natural and through sorcerous accident.
divinity_generator: Gain [20] Divinity when placing a [Buff] on an ally.
